method.selection: Six actual successful Bazel CI jobs from 2026-10-28: four PR synthetic merges, two devel pushes. Successful test/build/race child invocations and GitHub job clocks were read directly; this is a diagnostic sample, not a fleet quantile.
method.readiness_soak: The latest readiness change landed at approximately 07:08 UTC on October 28; these jobs represent roughly 12-13 post-change hours, not a full 24-hour soak.
method.counting: Only originating NEW RBE actions contribute worker/CPU sums. Cached or linked actions and overlapping test/action/trace durations are never added. Critical-path headroom is conditional, not a predicted saved job time. The Github job's queued interval is separate from occupied-runner interval. BuildBuddy wrapper gaps are not attributed to a particular setup phase without timestamps.

jobs.test_critical_culprit: VM action shared from devel invocation 275b2e4e; this PR did not originate its 924s process cost

vm_mechanism.finding: runner_start synchronously runs the full 11-subtest real-systemd kernel fixture before exec of the actual runner on every VM boot. All three scenarios start independent Sandboxes; console logs show fixture completion immediately before real runner logs and Ready. This is causal serial pre-readiness work in the current boot path, introduced with #12503, but it does not establish that #12503 caused the full VM action increase because image and source state differ.
vm_mechanism.fixture_stack_detail: 38906ea: node 20.3s, KubeVirt+Kyverno 125.1s, fixture images 221.3s, manifests 228s, deployments 264s. c8444c: node 11.3s, KubeVirt+Kyverno 29.6s, fixture images 43.1s, image imports 118.9s, deployments 121.8s. Both actions used the same observed worker ID but that alone does not prove image/snapshot state.

race_mechanism.finding: The newly added Go race test command runs only after main test and build, changes global rules_go race configuration and discards the Bazel analysis cache. Some go_test targets already declare race=on, including runner_test. Existing devel execution records prove that runner_test GoLink was newly executed with distinct action digests in both main and race phases of both examined jobs; runner_test TestRunner was newly executed in both phases for c8444c, while the 38906ea race TestRunner was linked/shared. Pinned rules_go v0.63.0 per-target transition makes race=on independent of the global default. A read-only Bazel query found 15 go_test labels already race=on; these are candidates to subtract from the second invocation while preserving their coverage in the main test.
race_mechanism.limits: Do not claim a whole 81-170s saving from excluding 15 labels: the second invocation and analysis/configuration switch remain for other Go tests. A matched fresh PR or isolated test would be needed. Bazel server lock/memory makes simple concurrent invocations a poor assumption.

runner_test_duplicate_evidence.safe_wording: main and global-race phase do not canonicalize runner_test GoLink or TestRunner action digests. A fresh runner_test GoLink originated in both phases of both devel jobs; a fresh TestRunner originated in both phases only for c8444c. The 38906ea race TestRunner was linked/shared (linkType 2) from another invocation, not newly originated by that race invocation. Distinct action digests and per-target race=on establish duplication candidate, but excluding already-race-on targets has no measured whole-command saving.
runner_test_duplicate_evidence.link_type_basis: Observed invocationLinkType 1 for all 239 and all 210 main-test actions, and 32/61 first-race and 17/17 second-race actions; type 2 for the remaining 29 first-race linked actions. Count only type 1 as originating NEW in this diagnostic.

bounded_vm_spike.status: Passed 3/3 VM cases on the corrected RBE spike. BuildBuddy runner snapshot workspace sync timed out and an automatic retry hit upstream connection reset before Bazel started; eventual run completed successfully.
bounded_vm_spike.patch_scope: In the isolated clone only, remove synchronous proof invocation in guest/runner_start and the two proof-file-only lines of test_vm_sandbox.py. Preserve PID1, UID, cgroup, systemctl denial, Claude turn, Codex turn and Codex OOM checks. No commit or production change.

test_result.proof_absence_checked: All three downloaded spike guest consoles lack TestSystemdKernelFixture and proof markers, while JUnit confirms three passing scenario cases.

bounded_vm_spike.comparison_limit: Until a separate all-11-subtest proof target is added, the spike deliberately lacks that proof gate and is only a mechanism/timing probe, never a deployable validation. Changed guest entrypoint rebuilds the guest image; compare VM test action/case/Ready phases and cache disposition, not raw whole-command duration.

ranked_next_experiments: Create a dedicated real-systemd proof VM test target covering all 11 existing subtests, executed in parallel with unchanged three-scenario VM coverage; remove synchronous proof from ordinary runner_start only after exact-source matched validation that proof target and all three scenarios pass and end-to-end gate shortens. This targets 86-143s of serial per-suite proof observed in six guest boots, bounded by other test/actions and gates, at the cost of another VM fixture action.

Query already race=on go_test labels in _race_targets and exclude them from global-race second invocation. Keep those labels in main Bazel test. Compare identical affected-target selections with fresh cache disposition and preserve all race target coverage; expect potentially smaller Go-link/test tail, not whole-command removal.

If VM readiness remains dominant after removing proof, examine separate fixture image import and KubeVirt startup components with paired same-source and same-worker/snapshot state; 38906ea fixture stack 265.5s vs c8444c 122.8s is observational and confounded.

buildbuddy_method.target_verdict_definition: The original startTime >= invocation creation partition is only a temporal proxy and is not a cache/fresh-execution classifier. Exact-label bbapi target responses expose testSummary.totalRunCount and totalNumCached; cache status is classified from those fields, with executionInfo.strategy and direct execution IDs used where present. Counts are per invocation/target and still do not guarantee unique physical RBE executions unless execution IDs are deduplicated.

target_history_status_totals.note: Counts span 1,675 target labels and overlap by invocation. Failed-to-build downstream labels are consequences, not independent test failures. One nonzero-time FAILED_TO_BUILD row is outside the dominant build-failure clusters and is not generalized.

zero_retry_before_after.interpretation: Descriptive source/time-mixed cohorts, not a treatment effect or default-retry counterfactual. The earlier focused pilot overlaps the broad window and is not added.

buildbuddy_method.freshness_status: Exact cache audit complete for six ranked labels across 234 completed mainline invocations. Do not use target-history startTime versus invocation-created-at as a cache classifier: cache hits occur after invocation creation. Use testSummary totalRunCount and totalNumCached; JSON omits totalNumCached when its protobuf scalar default is zero, which this audit confirmed with complete matching strategy=remote result events. Non-cached result runs still are not unique physical executions unless execution IDs are deduplicated.

cache_summary_probe.method: bbapi target "$INVOCATION_ID" --label "$TARGET_LABEL" --json; inspect targetGroups[].targets[].testSummary.totalRunCount and totalNumCached, plus testResultEvents[].testResult.executionInfo.strategy. For direct execution deduplication, query bbapi execution "$INVOCATION_ID" --json.

field_semantics.totalNumCached_omission: The protobuf JSON encoder omits scalar totalNumCached when its default value is zero. In all audited non-cached summaries (106 across these labels), matching result-event strategy rows fully covered totalRunCount and reported strategy=remote; omission therefore represented zero, confirmed by the result strategy. If event coverage or strategy is incomplete, classify the missing count as unknown, not zero.
field_semantics.distinct_counts: Keep target verdict count, cached/non-cached test-result run count, and unique physical RBE execution IDs separate. A non-cached run is not automatically a unique action when execution sharing/merging may occur.
